title: Bram and the Machine
author: Zephyrine Sterling
blurb: Emrys Coldharbour, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
